name: Maple's Bramble Cottage
author: Marinara Engine
description: A recipe journal on a sunlit kitchen counter. Linen and morning light by day, a lamplit walnut kitchen by night (follows the time of day). Fraunces headings, Nunito text, one sage hand stitch, a book-width reading column for long replies, washi tape on your notes. No motion, no HTML.
